notes.title: Beta Release 80 Now Scheduled for Tuesday, March 19, 2019
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26782085/7f5595cbd54acb928d360c782279e14052264262.jpg[/img]

We are targeting Beta Release 80 for Tuesday, March 19, between 10:00am - 1:00pm PDT / 5:00pm - 8:00pm UTC.

[b]Note: There is a protocol change in this version.[/b]

[h1][b]New in v0.80.0![/b][/h1]
[list][*] [b]Added Clock to Tablet:[/b] Local time is displayed in the upper right of the tablet in HMD, above the username (or log in, if not logged in).
[*] [b]Downloadable Assets:[/b] Content creators can now download their assets for their Marketplace items, including both approved and invalidated items. This is supported on the web-based Marketplace by opening it in a browser; it is not yet supported using the Market app.
[*][b]Digital Ocean Password Reset:[/b] Domain Admin users can now reset their admin username and password on Digital Ocean Domain Servers. Go to highfidelity.com/user/cloud_domains, sign in to High Fidelity, and select the Reset Domain Server password option from the menu.
[*][b]Avatar Doctor: [/b]The Avatar Packager now contains error detection, aka the “Avatar Doctor”. This tool will notify you of common errors before you upload your avatar files to our server for hosting. Coming in future releases: click on the error to view troubleshooting tips on how to resolve the error prior to uploading your avatar.
[/list]
For full release notes, please see the [url=https://forums.highfidelity.com/t/beta-release-80-now-scheduled-for-tuesday-march-19-2019/15470]forum[/url].

[list]

[list]

[b]

[/b]

Avatars

We've made improvements to the way avatars look at each other. Previously, avatars facing each other in conversation do not maintain eye contact if a single avatar appears behind one of the two. Now, your avatar focuses on: 
[list]
[*] Avatars that are currently talking when with avatars facing you and are an equal distance away from you.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Avatars that are facing you when they are an equal distance away from you.

[list]

[list]

[list]

[list]
[*] Optimizations and improvements to our Server/Network infrastructure address avatar performance and the issue of white-spheres lingering around.
[/list]
[list]

[list]

[/list]

Avatars
[list]
[*] Options now display correctly when calibrating settings for the Vive (Menu > Settings > Controls > Calibration).
[/list]
[list]
[*] Avatars with long necks and odd proportions now scale correctly.
[/list]
[list]
[*] When removing the HMD, the avatar's head will remain in a neutral position. This was correct in our Rift headset and brings parity to the Vive headset.[/list]
Create Tools
[list]
[*] Replaced the default values for a particle's 'Horizontal Angle' constraints to -180 and 180, so that they are in sync with the 'Vertical Angle'.
[/list]
[list]

[/list]
[list]
[*] Removed white edges from transparent image entities.
[/list]
[list]
[*] The Color Picker now correctly updates a new entity's color when using the Color Picker with multiple entities.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Sections of the Properties tab in the Create app now collapse correctly.
[/list]
[list]
[*] When changing the registration point on a Polyline, the bounding box/line now moves as expected.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue when certain scripts would cause skyboxes to disappear when creating.
[/list]
Other
[list]
[*] Multiple wearables are now displayed correctly in the Avatar App, and you can adjust them. [/list]
[*] Corrected the voxel size of entities.
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues regarding scripting/coding:
[list]
[*] Signal function fires correctly now as described in the documentation here: https://docs.highfidelity.com/api-reference/namespaces/myavatar#.collisionWithEntity
[/list]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where we were sending a signal to screen changed before anything had actually changed. This was causing any .js script listening to consider an App open/visible and ready to receive messages before it really was.
[/list][/list]
Crash Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash that could occur when Polylines were changed in the Create App.
[/list]

notes.title: Beta Release 73 + Global System Upgrade | Wed, Sep 26 at 2:00 pm PDT
notes.content:
[b]Important Update Related to This Scheduled Release[/b]
The time has been pushed back to 2:00 pm PDT, Wed Sept 26, 2018, we plan to upgrade our database in order to optimize the performance of this latest version. We anticipate that this database upgrade will take up to one hour. Once the upgrade is complete, we will immediately begin to roll out the release.

[b]What Will Be Affected During the Database Upgrade?[/b]
During this upgrade, centralized High Fidelity services will stop functioning, including user logins, place name navigation, and Marketplace. Partial functionality may resurface intermittently during the upgrade. If you are in a domain during the upgrade, you will likely remain there, but attempts to visit any other domain may fail. High Fidelity’s owned and managed domains, including Welcome, will be down.

[b]Will the Timing of Beta Release 73 Change?[/b]
The release will start to roll out as soon as the upgrade is complete. We anticipate this being somewhere between 1:30-2:30 pm PDT.

[b]Does This Upgrade Affect What’s in the Release?[/b]
No, the improvements and fixes for Beta Release 73 remain unchanged from what we announced last week on our forum. As a reminder, here’s what to expect:

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Make Things Glow:[/b] In Create mode, you will notice there is a new section in the Zone Entity settings where you can enable and configure bloom properties. 

[*][b]More Accurate Teleporting:[/b] Both collisions at the teleport target and your avatar height will be taken into consideration when you try to find a spot to teleport to while in VR mode.

[*][b]Simpler Wallet:[/b] Your wallet is now automatically associated with your user account! This means if you log into another device, you will be able to access your wallet. No more pesky passphrases.

[*][b]Login at Launch:[/b] When you start up High Fidelity Interface, you will be prompted to log in.

[*][b]Scaling Creations is Easier:[/b] One single handle in the center of an Entity will allow you to adjust the scale in Create mode.

[*][b]More Sensible Placement of Newly-created Entities:[/b] No more looking around to find your new Entity. It will be placed right in front of you.
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Mouth movements now match the audio when you playback a clip made with the Record script
[*]The Delete key works in Create mode on macOS
[*]Create menus minimize when High Fidelity is minimized
[*]A complete list of Entities will display in the Create menu
[/list]
Please note: There will be a protocol change, which means you will need to download the latest version in order to visit domains running v0.73.0.

[b]IMPORTANT NOTE FOR SIXENSE HYDRA USERS[/b] 
We stopped shipping native support for the Sixense Hydra several beta releases ago. However, we have continued to allow users to install support manually using an external manual installation process. Those old plugins have a bug that will prevent High Fidelity's Interface from starting up correctly. We will fix those external plugins shortly. In the meantime, if you experience a freeze when you startup, you may need to remove the sixense_x64.dll from the installation directory to get High Fidelity Interface to launch successfully.

notes.title: Update: Client-Only Installer
notes.content:
We wanted to update you on a change we've made! We have updated High Fidelity on Steam to use a client-only installer that lets you explore the metaverse, play with objects, and socialize with others around the world in VR. A client-only installer requires fewer resources from your computer. 
 
[b]Why the change? [/b]
 
We are removing the auto-download Sandbox component to ensure a faster and leaner install. We found that while some users want to jump in right away hosting their own content in Sandbox, many would rather explore the metaverse first.
 
[b]What if I still want to host content?[/b] 

High Fidelity still offers content creators to host their own content, with the option to share it with the world. To do this, you’ll need the Sandbox component of High Fidelity. Get our client + sandbox for local content creation here: https://highfidelity.com/download/sandbox

[b]Will this impact my in-world experience?[/b] 

No, your in-world experience is not affected by this change.

[b]I already have content that I built on my Sandbox. How do I retrieve it?[/b] 

Your content is safely stored in your local system on your computer. To download and install the client + sandbox version of High Fidelity, please head on over to https://highfidelity.com/download/sandbox. 

Then, to retrieve your content, 1) click on system tray in the bottom right 2) click on the High Fidelity icon and 3) click Home. You should automatically see that your content is back for you to continue building. 

[b]Questions?[/b]

We're happy to answer questions. Please feel free to get in touch with us at support@highfidelity.com . Thanks!

notes.title: Beta Release 45
notes.content:
Beta Release 45 includes up to Developer Release 6767. There is a protocol change in this release, you will need to update to visit domains running this version. This release should be live within one hour of the timestamp on this post.

 - Fixed a bug where custom port wasn't used in AC when passed through CLI 
 - Remove /tutorial in favor of new repo 
 - Revamp audio device selection
 - Fixed a bug where you could not print polaroids if you took a gif 
 - Ensure desktop dialogs' title bars are visible 
 - Fix teleporting to another user from the PAL 
 - Prevent deadlocks from different locking orders in FileCache 
 - Fix tablet buttons qt59
 - Baked shortBow's textures. 
 - Domain server settings will now tell user if saving will restart DS 
* Move `RenderArgs` out of `shared` and into `render`
  * `RenderArgs` required bizarre amounts of forward declarations because the concept of rendering was baked into the `OctreeRenderer` class (see below).
* Remove `RenderArgs::_whiteTexture`
  * This member was used in a few places to 'reset' a texture slot, but it was nowhere initialized, so it was always empty.  Where it was previously referenced, we're now explicitly setting the texture to nothing.
* Remove `QSharedPointer<OctreeRenderer> RenderArgs::_renderer;` in favor of `        `QSharedPointer<QObject> RenderArgs::_renderData;`
  * The `_renderer` type was always cast to a `QSharedPointer<EntityTreeRenderer>` in places where it was used, so there's no need to have this forward declaration anymore.
* Remove the concept of rendering from `octree` entirely
  * The class `OctreeRenderer` has been renamed `OctreeProcessor` (for lack of a better idea)
  * Move the `OctreeHeadlessViewer` and `EntityTreeHeadlessViewer` out of `octree` and `entities` and into `assignment-client`
